ui_bugs.issue: Profile shows 5 goal chips: Fat Loss, Muscle Gain, Maintain, Beginner Phase, Recovery Phase. The chip labelled 'Recovery Phase' does NOT match any backend fitness_goal value (backend accepts: fat_loss, muscle_gain, lean_bulk, recomposition, maintenance, beginner). If 'recovery' is sent, backend silently falls back to default protein/calorie factors (no error). Also Recomposition and Lean Bulk are exposed on Home chips but absent on Profile — inconsistent goal taxonomy across screens.

issues: Console emits Minified React error #418 (hydration/text content mismatch) when switching meal-count chips. Functionality still works (cards re-render 3->5->6), but should be cleaned up.

action_items: FRONTEND: Align Profile fitness-goal chip taxonomy with Home/backend. Profile currently uses 'recovery' which is NOT a backend fitness_goal value (backend silently falls back to defaults). Use the same set as Home: fat_loss, muscle_gain, maintenance, beginner, recomposition, lean_bulk (or whichever 5-6 you want to expose) so the value sent matches GOAL_CAL_FACTOR / GOAL_PROTEIN_PER_KG keys.
FRONTEND: Investigate React minified error #418 on /meal-plan when changing meal-count (hydration / text content mismatch). Non-blocking but pollutes console.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 4444 lines — exceeds 700-line guideline. compute_daily_targets/split_targets_into_meals/goal_fit_for_product cluster (lines 406-561) is a clean unit and would be a good extraction into a goal_targets.py module.
compute_daily_targets() uses Python round() (banker's rounding) — e.g. 2774.5 -> 2774. Acceptable but worth noting if QA expects strict away-from-zero rounding.

GET /user/daily-target ALWAYS recomputes from stored stats (good — keeps targets fresh if stats change). Persisted daily_calories on user doc and recomputed value can drift if stats edit happens via another path; consider single source of truth.

goal_fit_for_product fallback when no goal-fitting items exist: meal-plan returns 'or fitting' (all products) — this is sensible but means a 'Fits your goal' pill could be shown for non-fitting items if the pill is rendered from suggestions array unconditionally. UI seems to gate the pill correctly (23 pills observed, matching only_fit set).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 2/3 backend is solid. New regression file is /app/backend/tests/test_goal_personalization_phase23.py — run with pytest. BASE_URL defaults to the preview URL from frontend/.env (override via env BASE_URL). Mobile UI testing requires typing OTP via page.keyboard.type (not page.fill) because RN web TextInput needs onChangeText events; otherwise fills look correct but state stays empty and Verify silently no-ops. Frontend bug to confirm fix: profile GOALS array uses 'recovery' instead of 'recomposition' (frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx).
rca of the issue: Profile goal chip 'Recovery Phase' is a frontend-only label/value not recognized by backend. Backend's GOAL_CAL_FACTOR/GOAL_PROTEIN_PER_KG (server.py:417-432) keys are: fat_loss, muscle_gain, lean_bulk, recomposition, maintenance, beginner. When the mobile app POSTs fitness_goal='recovery' it hits the .get(...,1.0) and .get(...,1.6) defaults — calories computed as TDEE*1.0 and protein as 1.6 g/kg (i.e. equivalent to maintenance) without any error surfaced to the user. Fix: rename the chip value to 'recomposition' in frontend/app/(tabs)/profile.tsx GOALS array and align label set with home chips.
